# @agimon-ai/doompi-web

Package-owned guidance for the DoomPi web cockpit.

## Resources

- [Package README](./README.md): Running the cockpit, the bridge's security stance, what each
  surface renders, and the limits of what Pi RPC exposes. Its Security section states why loopback
  binding is not on its own an authorization boundary and what the origin and host guard refuses;
  its Planned section records why a WebRTC transport is wanted, for realtime voice as much as for
  keeping a tunnel provider out of the data path.
